outcomeClusters.title: Circuit Diagrams & Analysis Tools
outcomes: Construct a circuit diagram including the symbols for batteries, bulbs, resistors, and switches to represent a real circuit.
Construct a VIR chart from a circuit diagram (three or fewer components).

outcomeClusters.title: Ohm's Law
outcomes: Use Ohm's law to calculate any of the three quantities.
Apply Ohm's law to any series circuit and simple parallel circuits.

outcomeClusters.title: Current
outcomes: Define current and calculate current as charge per unit time.

outcomeClusters.title: Resistance
outcomes: Describe how resistance is related to thickness or length of wire.
Differentiate total resistance from the individual resistance of each component.
Find equivalent resistances in series and in parallel and use them to analyze a circuit.
